description: Internal finisher for local blue-green self-deployment. After restart_with_manifest activates the new color, complete_swap runs on the new active color and tears down the prior color: signals prior_pid, waits briefly, escalates if needed, and unregisters prior_instance_id from the local router. This process is not operator-discoverable; it is targeted by durable follow-up actions.
embedding_description: Complete local blue-green swap after activation. Green-side finisher that receives prior_pid, prior_instance_id, and prior_color, terminates the old solet process, unregisters it from the local router, and returns status, prior_instance_id, prior_color, and steps_completed. Internal durable action, not normal operator command.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Envelope with status, prior_instance_id, prior_color, and steps_completed.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: For internal logs, surface status and steps_completed. Operators normally should not see this unless investigating a swap failure.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Complete a local blue-green swap by stopping and unregistering the prior color.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Failures usually indicate OS signal permission problems, an unexpected prior_pid state, or local router unavailability.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Inspect local router status, process table, and the solet logs. If the old process is already gone and the router no longer lists it, treat the operation as effectively complete.
